svg.title: Start semantic sigil (Mosofin)
svg.desc: Verbatim geometry from mosofin/renderers/shared/utils.mjs SIGIL_SHAPE.start (tone frontend). In the viewer the group is placed at translate(nodeX+6, nodeY+6) scale(0.6875) and inherits fill none, stroke currentColor, stroke-width 1.35, round caps and joins, opacity 0.76. currentColor resolves to --frontend-stroke: #0891b2 (light) / #0891b2 (dark).
